name: Turing Lab
summary: Build and simulate formal languages and automata in an interactive learning workspace.
intro: Explore automata, grammars, regular expressions and Turing machines through editable models and step-by-step traces. Bundled examples provide a starting point for classroom exercises and independent study.

features.title: Visual models
features.body: Create and edit automata on a responsive canvas.

features.title: Simulation and traces
features.body: Follow bounded simulations for finite automata, pushdown automata and Turing machines.

features.title: Conversions and exercises
features.body: Explore grammar transformations, regular expressions, transducers, L-systems and Pumping Lemma exercises.

features.title: Import and export
features.body: Exchange supported document formats with compatibility and loss diagnostics.

support.title: Start with an example
paragraphs: Choose a workspace and open a bundled example before building your own model.

support.title: When a simulation stops
paragraphs: Check the input, transition definitions and execution limits. A bounded run ending does not always prove rejection.

support.title: Opening and saving files
paragraphs: Choose the format supported by your workspace and read compatibility warnings before export. On the web, exported files use browser downloads.

support.title: Platform availability
paragraphs: The project targets Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS and Linux. Source feature availability does not establish store availability or validation on every device.

privacy.title: Local learning data
paragraphs: Models and simulations are processed by the application. Preferences, active sessions, teaching sessions and simulation history can be saved in local application or browser storage.

privacy.title: Files you choose
paragraphs: Import reads selected documents. Export writes or downloads the selected content; exported copies remain wherever you save them.

privacy.title: Network and external links
paragraphs: Bundled examples do not require a network connection. Help, support and project links open external websites when selected; the web version also needs its host to deliver the application.

privacy.title: Analytics and AI
paragraphs: The inspected application code does not include a cloud AI provider or an integrated analytics or crash-reporting service.

privacy.title: Removing local data
paragraphs: Clear the relevant local application or browser site data to remove stored sessions and preferences. Manage exported files separately; clearing browser storage can remove unsaved local work.
